#A29. Complete. Complete.
```{r}
# New classification: 
# A29
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
citation("ggplot2")
packageVersion("ggplot2")
library(janitor)
library(readxl)
library(plotly)

# Load the data with tab separator
# Load CSV with default comma separator
deer_data_labels <- read_excel("<LOCAL_PATH>")

colnames(deer_data_labels)

# Convert to POSIXct format
deer_data_labels$date <- as.POSIXct(
    deer_data_labels$date,
    format = "%m/%d/%y %H:%M",
    tz = "UTC"
)


# Check if the dataset is empty
if(nrow(deer_data_labels) == 0) {
  stop("Dataset is empty! Check file path and delimiter.")
}

# Print first few rows to inspect data
print(head(deer_data_labels))

# Automatically clean column names
deer_data_labels <- deer_data_labels %>% clean_names()

# Print cleaned column names
print(colnames(deer_data_labels))

# Check unique IDs
print(unique(deer_data_labels$id))

# Ensure "id" column is treated as character
deer_data_labels$id <- as.character(deer_data_labels$id)

# Re-check unique IDs
print(unique(deer_data_labels$id))

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Function to create an interactive plot for a single deer
location_plot_interactive <- function(deer_data) {
  gg <- ggplot(data = deer_data, 
             aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, 
                 color = migration_status, text = paste("Date:", date))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("Movement of Deer ID:", unique(deer_data$id)),
       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", color = "Movement Behavior") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("resident" = "blue", 
                                  "migratory" = "red", 
                                  "transition to migratory" = "orange",
                                  "transition to resident" = "green",
                                  "remove" = "black"))

  # Convert ggplot to interactive plotly object
  ggplotly(gg, tooltip = "text")  # Enables hover info
}

# Create and display the interactive plot for the single ID in the dataset
location_plot_interactive(deer_data_labels)

# Function to create a static GGplot2 plot for a single deer
location_plot_static <- function(deer_data) {
  ggplot(data = deer_data, 
         aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = migration_status)) +
    geom_path(aes(group = id), alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 1) +  # Connects movement paths
    geom_point(aes(size = 2), alpha = 0.8) +  # Plot individual points
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Movement of Deer ID:", unique(deer_data$id)),
         x = "Longitude",
         y = "Latitude",
         color = "migration_status") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("resident" = "blue", 
                                  "migratory" = "red", 
                                  "transition to migratory" = "orange",
                                  "transition to resident" = "green",
                                  "Remove" = "black"))
}


# Create and display the plot for the single ID in the dataset
location_plot_static(deer_data_labels)



```

```{r}
deer_data_labels <- read_excel("<LOCAL_PATH>")

# Convert to POSIXct format
deer_data_labels$date <- as.POSIXct(
    deer_data_labels$date,
    format = "%m/%d/%y %H:%M",
    tz = "UTC"
)


# Check if the dataset is empty
if(nrow(deer_data_labels) == 0) {
  stop("Dataset is empty! Check file path and delimiter.")
}

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Function to create an interactive plot for a single deer
location_plot_interactive <- function(deer_data) {
  gg <- ggplot(data = deer_data, 
             aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, 
                 color = migration_status, text = paste("Date:", date))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("Movement of Deer ID:", unique(deer_data$id)),
       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", color = "Movement Behavior") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("resident" = "blue", 
                                  "migratory" = "red", 
                                  "transition to migratory" = "orange",
                                  "transition to resident" = "green",
                                  "excursion" = "purple",
                                  "Remove" = "black"))

  # Convert ggplot to interactive plotly object
  ggplotly(gg, tooltip = "text")  # Enables hover info
}

# Create and display the interactive plot for the single ID in the dataset
location_plot_interactive(deer_data_labels)

# Function to create a static GGplot2 plot for a single deer
location_plot_static <- function(deer_data) {
  ggplot(data = deer_data, 
         aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = migration_status)) +
    geom_path(aes(group = id), alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +  # Connects movement paths
    geom_point(aes(size = 2), alpha = 0.8) +  # Plot individual points
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Movement of Deer ID:", unique(deer_data$id)),
         x = "Longitude",
         y = "Latitude",
         color = "migration_status") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("resident" = "blue", 
                                  "migratory" = "red", 
                                  "transition to migratory" = "orange",
                                  "transition to resident" = "green",
                                  "excursion" = "purple",
                                  "Remove" = "black"))
}


# Create and display the plot for the single ID in the dataset
location_plot_static(deer_data_labels)
```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
citation("ggplot2")
packageVersion("ggplot2")
library(janitor)
library(readxl)
```
```{r}
library(plotly)

# Load the data with tab separator
# Load CSV with default comma separator
deer_data_labels <- read_excel("<LOCAL_PATH>")

colnames(deer_data_labels)

# Convert to POSIXct format
deer_data_labels$date <- as.POSIXct(
    deer_data_labels$date,
    format = "%m/%d/%y %H:%M",
    tz = "UTC"
)


# Check if the dataset is empty
if(nrow(deer_data_labels) == 0) {
  stop("Dataset is empty! Check file path and delimiter.")
}

# Print first few rows to inspect data
print(head(deer_data_labels))

# Automatically clean column names
deer_data_labels <- deer_data_labels %>% clean_names()

# Print cleaned column names
print(colnames(deer_data_labels))

# Check unique IDs
print(unique(deer_data_labels$id))

# Ensure "id" column is treated as character
deer_data_labels$id <- as.character(deer_data_labels$id)

# Re-check unique IDs
print(unique(deer_data_labels$id))

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Function to create an interactive plot for a single deer
location_plot_interactive <- function(deer_data) {
  gg <- ggplot(data = deer_data, 
             aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, 
                 color = migration_status, text = paste("Date:", date))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("Movement of Deer ID:", unique(deer_data$id)),
       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", color = "Movement Behavior") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("resident" = "blue", 
                                  "migratory" = "red", 
                                  "transition to migratory" = "orange",
                                  "transition to resident" = "green",
                                  "excursion" = "purple",
                                  "Remove" = "black"))

  # Convert ggplot to interactive plotly object
  ggplotly(gg, tooltip = "text")  # Enables hover info
}

# Create and display the interactive plot for the single ID in the dataset
location_plot_interactive(deer_data_labels)

# Function to create a static GGplot2 plot for a single deer
location_plot_static <- function(deer_data) {
  ggplot(data = deer_data, 
         aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = migration_status)) +
    geom_path(aes(group = id), alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +  # Connects movement paths
    geom_point(aes(size = 2), alpha = 0.8) +  # Plot individual points
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Movement of Deer ID:", unique(deer_data$id)),
         x = "Longitude",
         y = "Latitude",
         color = "migration_status") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("resident" = "blue", 
                                  "migratory" = "red", 
                                  "transition to migratory" = "orange",
                                  "transition to resident" = "green",
                                  "excursion" = "purple",
                                  "Remove" = "black"))
}


# Create and display the plot for the single ID in the dataset
location_plot_static(deer_data_labels)
```

#Sanity check: 
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Movement Plot for One Deer with Excel File Path Included
# Fixes: .xlsx loading + migration_status color matching
# ============================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(plotly)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)

# ============================================================
# 1) File path
# ============================================================

FILE_PATH <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

# ============================================================
# 2) Load Excel file correctly
# ============================================================

deer_data_labels <- read_excel(FILE_PATH)

# ============================================================
# 3) Clean column names lightly
# ============================================================

names(deer_data_labels) <- names(deer_data_labels) %>%
  str_trim()

cat("\nColumn names after loadin<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(names(deer_data_labels))

cat("\nUnique IDs before cleanin<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(unique(deer_data_labels[["id"]]))

cat("\nOriginal migration_status value<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(unique(deer_data_labels[["migration_status"]]))

# ============================================================
# 4) Check required columns
# ============================================================

required_cols <- c("id", "date", "longitude", "latitude", "migration_status")

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(deer_data_labels))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "These required columns are missing from deer_data_labels:",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 5) Clean data
# ============================================================

deer_data_labels <- deer_data_labels %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(.data$id),

    date = parse_date_time(
      .data$date,
      orders = c(
        "ymd HMS",
        "ymd HM",
        "ymd",
        "mdy HMS",
        "mdy HM",
        "mdy"
      ),
      tz = "UTC"
    ),

    migration_status = as.character(.data$migration_status),
    migration_status = str_trim(.data$migration_status),
    migration_status = str_to_lower(.data$migration_status),
    migration_status = str_replace_all(.data$migration_status, "_", " "),
    migration_status = str_replace_all(.data$migration_status, "-", " "),
    migration_status = str_squish(.data$migration_status),

    migration_status = case_when(
      is.na(.data$migration_status) | .data$migration_status == "" ~ "resident",

      .data$migration_status %in% c(
        "resident",
        "res"
      ) ~ "resident",

      .data$migration_status %in% c(
        "migratory",
        "migration",
        "migrate"
      ) ~ "migratory",

      .data$migration_status %in% c(
        "transition to migratory",
        "transition migratory",
        "transition into migratory"
      ) ~ "transition to migratory",

      .data$migration_status %in% c(
        "transition to resident",
        "transition resident",
        "transition into resident"
      ) ~ "transition to resident",

      .data$migration_status %in% c(
        "excursion",
        "excursions"
      ) ~ "excursion",

      .data$migration_status %in% c(
        "dispersal",
        "dispersals"
      ) ~ "dispersal",

      TRUE ~ .data$migration_status
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 6) Check cleaned values
# ============================================================

cat("\nUnique IDs after cleanin<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(unique(deer_data_labels[["id"]]))

cat("\nCleaned migration_status count<LOCAL_PATH>")
deer_data_labels %>%
  count(migration_status, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# ============================================================
# 7) Color palette
# ============================================================

movement_colors <- c(
  "resident" = "blue",
  "migratory" = "red",
  "transition to migratory" = "orange",
  "transition to resident" = "green",
  "excursion" = "black",
  "dispersal" = "purple"
)

unknown_statuses <- setdiff(
  unique(deer_data_labels[["migration_status"]]),
  names(movement_colors)
)

if (length(unknown_statuses) > 0) {
  cat("\nWARNING: These migration_status values are not in movement_color<LOCAL_PATH>")
  print(unknown_statuses)
}

# ============================================================
# 8) Create plotting dataset
# ============================================================

deer_data_labels_plot <- deer_data_labels %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(.data$id),
    !is.na(.data$longitude),
    !is.na(.data$latitude),
    !is.na(.data$date),
    !is.na(.data$migration_status)
  ) %>%
  arrange(.data$id, .data$date)

cat("\nRows used for plottin<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(nrow(deer_data_labels_plot))

cat("\nIDs used for plottin<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(unique(deer_data_labels_plot[["id"]]))

# ============================================================
# 9) Static movement path plot
# ============================================================

location_plot_static <- function(deer_data) {

  ggplot(
    data = deer_data,
    aes(
      x = .data$longitude,
      y = .data$latitude,
      color = .data$migration_status
    )
  ) +
    geom_path(
      aes(group = .data$id),
      alpha = 0.6,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Movement Path of Deer ID:",
        paste(unique(deer_data[["id"]]), collapse = ", ")
      ),
      x = "Longitude",
      y = "Latitude",
      color = "Migration Status"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = movement_colors,
      drop = FALSE
    )
}

location_plot_static(deer_data_labels_plot)

# ============================================================
# 10) Interactive movement path plot
# ============================================================

location_plot_interactive <- function(deer_data) {

  gg <- ggplot(
    data = deer_data,
    aes(
      x = .data$longitude,
      y = .data$latitude,
      color = .data$migration_status,
      text = paste(
        "ID:", .data$id,
        "<br>Date:", .data$date,
        "<br>Status:", .data$migration_status,
        "<br>Longitude:", .data$longitude,
        "<br>Latitude:", .data$latitude
      )
    )
  ) +
    geom_path(
      aes(group = .data$id),
      alpha = 0.6,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Movement Path of Deer ID:",
        paste(unique(deer_data[["id"]]), collapse = ", ")
      ),
      x = "Longitude",
      y = "Latitude",
      color = "Migration Status"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = movement_colors,
      drop = FALSE
    )

  ggplotly(gg, tooltip = "text")
}

location_plot_interactive(deer_data_labels_plot)
```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# Plot R2n for resident deer
# One subplot per deer ID
# ============================================================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(fs)
library(janitor)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Folder with cleaned files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clean_dir <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

files <- dir_ls(
  clean_dir,
  recurse = FALSE
)

# Remove temporary Excel lock files
files <- files[!str_detect(basename(files), "^~\\$")]

cat("Cleaned files found:", length(files), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fill in resident deer IDs here
# Example: resident_ids <- c("A29", "A30", "A31")
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_ids <- c("F97", "F93", "F82", "F79", "F78", "F77", "F76", "F73", "F67", "F66", "F48", "F42", "F34", "F33", "F31", "F27", "F109", "F100", "A63", "A54", "A53", "A47", "A46", "A43", "A40", "A39", "A36", "F04")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Read one cleaned deer file
# ------------------------------------------------------------

read_one_cleaned_file <- function(file_path) {
  
  cat("Reading:", basename(file_path), "\n")
  
  deer <- read_excel(file_path) %>%
    clean_names()
  
  # If id column is missing, pull ID from filename
  if (!"id" %in% names(deer)) {
    deer_id_from_file <- basename(file_path) %>%
      str_extract("[AF][0-9]{2,3}")
    
    deer <- deer %>%
      mutate(id = deer_id_from_file)
  }
  
  deer <- deer %>%
    mutate(
      source_file = basename(file_path),
      
      id = as.character(id),
      id = str_trim(id),
      id = str_to_upper(id),
      id = str_replace_all(id, "[^A-Z0-9]", ""),
      
      date = parse_date_time(
        as.character(date),
        orders = c(
          "ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd",
          "mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "mdy",
          "dmy HMS", "dmy HM", "dmy"
        ),
        tz = "UTC"
      ),
      
      migration_status = as.character(migration_status),
      migration_status = str_trim(migration_status),
      migration_status = str_squish(migration_status)
    )
  
  return(deer)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine all cleaned files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_deer_cleaned <- map_dfr(files, read_one_cleaned_file)

cat("\nUnique IDs loade<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(sort(unique(all_deer_cleaned$id)))

cat("\nAvailable column<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(names(all_deer_cleaned))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check that r2n exists
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"r2n" %in% names(all_deer_cleaned)) {
  stop("The column 'r2n' was not found. Check the printed column names above.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean resident_ids the same way
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_ids <- resident_ids %>%
  as.character() %>%
  str_trim() %>%
  str_to_upper() %>%
  str_replace_all("[^A-Z0-9]", "")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Filter to resident IDs for plotting
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_r2n_data <- all_deer_cleaned %>%
  filter(
    id %in% resident_ids,
    !is.na(date),
    !is.na(r2n)
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, date)

cat("\nRows used for plottin<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(nrow(resident_r2n_data))

cat("\nResident IDs used for plottin<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(sort(unique(resident_r2n_data$id)))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Stop if no data found
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (nrow(resident_r2n_data) == 0) {
  stop("No rows found for the resident_ids you entered. Check that the IDs match the printed IDs above.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# R2n subplot plot: one panel per deer ID
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_r2n_subplot <- ggplot(
  resident_r2n_data,
  aes(
    x = date,
    y = r2n
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.45) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ id,
    scales = "free_x",
    ncol = 4
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(
    title = "R2n Over Time for Resident Deer",
    subtitle = "Each subplot shows one deer ID",
    x = "Date",
    y = "R2n"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.1, "lines")
  )

resident_r2n_subplot

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(clean_dir, "resident_deer_r2n_subplots.png"),
  plot = resident_r2n_subplot,
  width = 18,
  height = 14,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
    !is.na(date),
    !is.na(r2n)
  ) %>%

cat("\nRows used for plottin<LOCAL_PATH>")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
```

# EDA on cleaned datasets
```{r}
# ============================================================
# COMBINE MANUALLY LABELED DEER FILES + EDA
#
# Important logic:
# Migratory dataset = ALL cleaned rows for any ID that ever has
#                     migratory / transition to migratory / transition to resident
#
# Resident dataset  = ALL cleaned rows for IDs that never migrate
#
# This prevents keeping only Phase 1 or only "migratory" rows.
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Load required libraries
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# File paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

base_path <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

eda_out_dir <- file.path(base_path, "eda_outputs")
dir.create(eda_out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

migratory_out <- file.path(base_path, "combined_migratory_ids_cleaned.csv")
resident_out  <- file.path(base_path, "combined_resident_ids_cleaned.csv")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper function: safely parse date
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parse_datetime_safe <- function(x) {
  parse_date_time(
    x,
    orders = c(
      "mdy HM", "mdy HMS",
      "ymd HM", "ymd HMS",
      "Ymd HM", "Ymd HMS",
      "mdy", "ymd", "Ymd"
    ),
    tz = "UTC"
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Find all Excel files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

files <- list.files(
  path = base_path,
  pattern = "\\.xlsx$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Avoid reading temp Excel lock files
files <- files[!str_detect(basename(files), "^~\\$")]

cat("Files found:", length(files), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Read and combine all Excel files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_deer_raw <- map_dfr(files, function(file) {
  
  cat("Reading:", basename(file), "\n")
  
  df <- read_excel(file) %>%
    clean_names() %>%
    mutate(source_file = basename(file))
  
  return(df)
})

cat("\nTotal rows before cleaning:", nrow(all_deer_raw), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Standardize important columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Stop early if required columns are missing
required_cols <- c("id", "date", "migration_status", "phases")

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(all_deer_raw))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
    "\nAvailable columns ar<LOCAL_PATH>",
    paste(names(all_deer_raw), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

all_deer_raw <- all_deer_raw %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    date = as.character(date),
    migration_status = as.character(migration_status),
    phases = as.character(phases),
    
    migration_status_clean = migration_status %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_to_lower(),
    
    phases_clean = phases %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_to_lower()
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Relabel migration_status and remove unwanted transition rows
#
# Rules:
# dispersal  = migratory
# excursion  = resident
# transition to migratory = remove entire row
#
# Also remove rows explicitly labeled "remove" in migration_status or phases
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cleaned_deer_data <- all_deer_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # Standardize migration_status first
    migration_status_clean = migration_status %>%
      as.character() %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_to_lower(),
    
    phases_clean = phases %>%
      as.character() %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_to_lower()
  ) %>%
  
  # Remove unwanted rows
  filter(
    is.na(migration_status_clean) | migration_status_clean != "remove",
    is.na(phases_clean) | phases_clean != "remove",
    is.na(migration_status_clean) | migration_status_clean != "transition to migratory"
  ) %>%
  
  # Relabel migration status
  mutate(
    migration_status = case_when(
      migration_status_clean == "dispersal" ~ "migratory",
      migration_status_clean == "excursion" ~ "resident",
      TRUE ~ migration_status
    ),
    
    # Rebuild clean version after relabeling
    migration_status_clean = migration_status %>%
      as.character() %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_to_lower()
  )

cat("Total rows after relabeling and removing rows:", nrow(cleaned_deer_data), "\n")
cat("Rows removed:", nrow(all_deer_raw) - nrow(cleaned_deer_data), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Diagnose raw phases BEFORE splitting
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nRaw phase values before splittin<LOCAL_PATH>")

raw_phase_check <- cleaned_deer_data %>%
  count(phases, sort = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble()

print(raw_phase_check, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Identify migratory IDs
#
# An ID is migratory if it ever has:
# - migratory
# - transition to migratory
# - transition to resident
#
# Then we keep the entire cleaned range for that ID.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migratory_labels <- c(
  "migratory",
  "transition to migratory",
  "transition to resident"
)

migratory_ids <- cleaned_deer_data %>%
  filter(migration_status_clean %in% migratory_labels) %>%
  distinct(id) %>%
  arrange(id) %>%
  pull(id)

cat("\nMigratory IDs found:", length(migratory_ids), "\n")
print(migratory_ids)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Split datasets correctly
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migratory_data <- cleaned_deer_data %>%
  filter(id %in% migratory_ids) %>%
  mutate(dataset = "Migratory")

resident_data <- cleaned_deer_data %>%
  filter(!id %in% migratory_ids) %>%
  mutate(dataset = "Resident")

cat("\nMigratory rows:", nrow(migratory_data), "\n")
cat("Resident rows :", nrow(resident_data), "\n")

cat("\nUnique migratory IDs:", n_distinct(migratory_data$id), "\n")
cat("Unique resident IDs :", n_distinct(resident_data$id), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Phase check AFTER splitting
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nRaw phases in migratory dat<LOCAL_PATH>")

migratory_data %>%
  count(phases, sort = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  print(n = Inf)

cat("\nRaw phases in resident dat<LOCAL_PATH>")

resident_data %>%
  count(phases, sort = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Drop helper columns before exporting
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migratory_export <- migratory_data %>%
  select(-migration_status_clean, -phases_clean)

resident_export <- resident_data %>%
  select(-migration_status_clean, -phases_clean)

write_csv(migratory_export, migratory_out)
write_csv(resident_export, resident_out)

cat("\nSaved migratory CSV to:", migratory_out, "\n")
cat("Saved resident CSV to :", resident_out, "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Combine for EDA
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_deer_data <- bind_rows(
  migratory_export,
  resident_export
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Parse date and add time variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_deer_data <- all_deer_data %>%
  mutate(
    date = parse_datetime_safe(date),
    date_only = as.Date(date),
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date),
    hour = hour(date)
  )

migratory_data <- all_deer_data %>%

resident_data <- all_deer_data %>%

# ------------------------------------------------------------

glimpse(all_deer_data)

cat("\nMigratory rows:", nrow(migratory_data), "\n")
cat("Resident rows :", nrow(resident_data), "\n")
cat("Total rows    :", nrow(all_deer_data), "\n")

cat("\nUnique migratory IDs:", n_distinct(migratory_data$id), "\n")
```

# Checking for unrealistic points

```{r}
# ============================================================
# CHECK + FLAG + REMOVE UNREALISTIC MOVEMENTS
# Applies same workflow to Resident and Migratory datasets
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Function: flag and clean unrealistic movements
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clean_unrealistic_movements <- function(
    df,
    dataset_name,
    out_dir = NULL,
    dist_col = "dist",
    datetime_col = "date",
    id_col = "id",
    suspect_dist_threshold = 5000,
    suspect_gap_threshold_hr = 4,
    extreme_dist_threshold = 9000,
    remove_dist_threshold = 8000,
    remove_speed_threshold = 1300
) {
  
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("Processing:", dataset_name, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 1) Basic column checks
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  required_cols <- c(id_col, datetime_col, dist_col)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " is missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2) Standardize helper columns
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  df_working <- df %>%
    mutate(
      .id = as.character(.data[[id_col]]),
      .datetime = .data[[datetime_col]],
      .dist = as.numeric(.data[[dist_col]])
    ) %>%
    arrange(.id, .datetime)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 3) Summary of distance before cleaning
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  cat("\nDistance summary before cleanin<LOCAL_PATH>")
  print(summary(df_working$.dist))
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 4) Calculate time difference and speed
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  df_working <- df_working %>%
    group_by(.id) %>%
    mutate(
      time_diff_hr = as.numeric(difftime(.datetime, lag(.datetime), units = "hours"))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      time_diff_hr = if_else(time_diff_hr == 0, NA_real_, time_diff_hr),
      dist_per_hr = .dist / time_diff_hr
    )
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5) Create threshold flags
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  df_working <- df_working %>%
    mutate(
      suspect_jump = if_else(
        !is.na(.dist) & !is.na(time_diff_hr) &
          .dist > suspect_dist_threshold &
          time_diff_hr > suspect_gap_threshold_hr,
        1, 0
      ),
      extreme_jump = if_else(
        !is.na(.dist) & .dist > extreme_dist_threshold,
        1, 0
      )
    )
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 6) Visualize distance vs time gap before removal
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  p_time_dist <- ggplot(df_working, aes(x = time_diff_hr, y = .dist)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(
      title = paste(dataset_name, "- Distance vs Time Gap Between Fixes"),
      x = "Time Difference (hours, log scale)",
      y = "Distance (meters, log scale)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  print(p_time_dist)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 7) Visualize suspect jumps
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  p_suspect <- ggplot(df_working, aes(x = time_diff_hr, y = .dist, color = as.factor(suspect_jump))) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "gray", "1" = "red")) +
    labs(
      title = paste(dataset_name, "- Flagged Long-Distance Fixes with Large Time Gaps"),
      color = "Suspect Jump",
      x = "Time Difference (hours, log scale)",
      y = "Distance (meters, log scale)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  print(p_suspect)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8) Extract flagged IDs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  flagged_ids <- df_working %>%
    filter(suspect_jump == 1) %>%
    distinct(.id) %>%
    arrange(.id)
  
  cat("\nFlagged IDs for", dataset_name, ":\n")
  print(flagged_ids, n = Inf)
  
  flagged_vector <- flagged_ids$.id
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 9) Summary of suspect jumps by ID
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  suspect_summary <- df_working %>%
    filter(.id %in% flagged_vector, suspect_jump == 1) %>%
    group_by(.id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_flags = n(),
      max_time_gap = max(time_diff_hr, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_time_gap = median(time_diff_hr, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_dist = max(.dist, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_dist = median(.dist, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_speed = median(dist_per_hr, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_speed = max(dist_per_hr, na.rm = TRUE),
      time_gap_gt_6hr = any(time_diff_hr > 6, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_flags))
  
  cat("\nSuspect jump summary for", dataset_name, ":\n")
  print(suspect_summary, n = Inf)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 10) Identify flagged points with max distance / max gap
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  flagged_points <- df_working %>%
    filter(suspect_jump == 1, !is.na(.dist), !is.na(time_diff_hr)) %>%
    group_by(.id) %>%
    mutate(
      is_max_dist = .dist == max(.dist, na.rm = TRUE),
      is_max_gap = time_diff_hr == max(time_diff_hr, na.rm = TRUE),
      alignment = case_when(
        is_max_dist & is_max_gap ~ "Both Max Distance & Gap",
        is_max_dist ~ "Max Distance Only",
        is_max_gap ~ "Max Time Gap Only",
        TRUE ~ "Other Flagged Point"
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  flagged_points_display <- flagged_points %>%
    filter(alignment != "Other Flagged Point") %>%
    arrange(.id, desc(.dist)) %>%
    select(
      .id,
      .datetime,
      .dist,
      time_diff_hr,
      dist_per_hr,
      is_max_dist,
      is_max_gap,
      alignment
    )
  
  cat("\nMeaningful flagged points for", dataset_name, ":\n")
  print(flagged_points_display, n = Inf)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 11) Define points to remove
  #
  # Removal condition:
  # distance > 8000 meters OR speed > 1300 m/hr
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  unrealistic_points <- df_working %>%
    filter(!is.na(.dist), !is.na(time_diff_hr)) %>%
    filter(
      .dist > remove_dist_threshold |
        dist_per_hr > remove_speed_threshold
    )
  
  cat("\nUnrealistic points to remove for", dataset_name, ":\n")
  print(unrealistic_points, n = Inf)
  
  unrealistic_summary <- unrealistic_points %>%
    select(
      all_of(id_col),
      all_of(datetime_col),
      all_of(dist_col),
      time_diff_hr,
      dist_per_hr,
      suspect_jump,
      extreme_jump
    )
  
  cat("\nUnrealistic summary for", dataset_name, ":\n")
  print(unrealistic_summary, n = Inf)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 12) Remove unrealistic points
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  cleaned_df <- df_working %>%
    anti_join(
      unrealistic_summary %>%
        select(all_of(id_col), all_of(datetime_col)),
      by = setNames(c(id_col, datetime_col), c(id_col, datetime_col))
    )
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 13) Visualize cleaned data
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  p_cleaned <- ggplot(cleaned_df, aes(x = time_diff_hr, y = .dist)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2, color = "steelblue") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(
      title = paste(dataset_name, "- Cleaned Distance vs Time Gap"),
      x = "Time Difference (hours, log scale)",
      y = "Distance (meters, log scale)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  print(p_cleaned)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 13b) Latitude / Longitude over time by ID
  # Useful for spotting large data gaps or weird jumps
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (all(c("latitude", "longitude") %in% names(cleaned_df))) {
    
    p_lat_time <- ggplot(cleaned_df, aes(x = .datetime, y = latitude)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = "steelblue") +
      facet_wrap(~ .id, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(
        title = paste(dataset_name, "- Latitude Over Time by Individual"),
        x = "Date-Time",
        y = "Latitude"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
    
    print(p_lat_time)
    
    p_lon_time <- ggplot(cleaned_df, aes(x = .datetime, y = longitude)) +
      geom_line(alpha = 0.7, color = "darkgreen") +
      facet_wrap(~ .id, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(
        title = paste(dataset_name, "- Longitude Over Time by Individual"),
        x = "Date-Time",
        y = "Longitude"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
    
    print(p_lon_time)
    
  } else {
    
    cat(
      "\nSkipping latitude/longitude over time plots for",
      dataset_name,
      "- latitude and/or longitude columns not found.\n"
    )
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 14) Analysis of unrealistic points
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (nrow(unrealistic_points) > 0) {
    
    cat("\nSummary of unrealistic points for", dataset_name, ":\n")
    print(summary(unrealistic_points))
    
    cat("\nStructure of unrealistic points for", dataset_name, ":\n")
    print(str(unrealistic_points))
    
    cat("\nMissing values in unrealistic points for", dataset_name, ":\n")
    missing_counts <- unrealistic_points %>%
      summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.))))
    print(missing_counts)
    
    cat("\nID counts in unrealistic points for", dataset_name, ":\n")
    id_counts <- unrealistic_points %>%
      group_by(.id) %>%
      summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(count))
    print(id_counts, n = Inf)
    
    if ("migration_status" %in% names(unrealistic_points)) {
      cat("\nMigration status counts in unrealistic points for", dataset_name, ":\n")
      migration_status_counts <- unrealistic_points %>%
        group_by(migration_status) %>%
        summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
        arrange(desc(count))
      print(migration_status_counts, n = Inf)
    }
    
    # Histogram of distances
    p_unrealistic_dist <- ggplot(unrealistic_points, aes(x = .dist)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
      labs(
        title = paste(dataset_name, "- Distribution of Unrealistic Distances"),
        x = "Distance (meters)",
        y = "Count"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    print(p_unrealistic_dist)
    
    # Histogram of time differences
    p_unrealistic_time <- ggplot(unrealistic_points, aes(x = time_diff_hr)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "tomato", color = "black") +
      labs(
        title = paste(dataset_name, "- Distribution of Unrealistic Time Differences"),
        x = "Time Difference (hours)",
        y = "Count"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    print(p_unrealistic_time)
    
    # Histogram of speed
    p_unrealistic_speed <- ggplot(unrealistic_points, aes(x = dist_per_hr)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "forestgreen", color = "black") +
      labs(
        title = paste(dataset_name, "- Distribution of Unrealistic Speed"),
        x = "Distance per Hour (m/hr)",
        y = "Count"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    print(p_unrealistic_speed)
    
    # Distance vs time difference
    p_unrealistic_scatter <- ggplot(unrealistic_points, aes(x = time_diff_hr, y = .dist)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "purple") +
      scale_x_log10() +
      scale_y_log10() +
      labs(
        title = paste(dataset_name, "- Unrealistic Distance vs Time Difference"),
        x = "Time Difference (hours, log scale)",
        y = "Distance (meters, log scale)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    print(p_unrealistic_scatter)
    
    # Speed vs time difference
    p_speed_time <- ggplot(unrealistic_points, aes(x = time_diff_hr, y = dist_per_hr)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkblue") +
      labs(
        title = paste(dataset_name, "- Distance per Hour vs Time Difference"),
        x = "Time Difference (hours)",
        y = "Distance per Hour (m/hr)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    print(p_speed_time)
    
    # Boxplot by ID
    p_box_id <- ggplot(unrealistic_points, aes(x = factor(.id), y = .dist)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(
        title = paste(dataset_name, "- Unrealistic Distance by ID"),
        x = "ID",
        y = "Distance (meters)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
    
    print(p_box_id)
    
    # Correlation matrix
    numeric_vars <- unrealistic_points %>%
      select(.dist, time_diff_hr, dist_per_hr)
    
    cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_vars, use = "complete.obs")
    
    cat("\nCorrelation matrix for", dataset_name, ":\n")
    print(cor_matrix)
    
    # Quantiles
    dist_quantiles <- quantile(unrealistic_points$.dist, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.05), na.rm = TRUE)
    time_diff_quantiles <- quantile(unrealistic_points$time_diff_hr, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.05), na.rm = TRUE)
    speed_quantiles <- quantile(unrealistic_points$dist_per_hr, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.05), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\nDistance Quantiles for", dataset_name, ":\n")
    print(dist_quantiles)
    
    cat("\nTime Difference Quantiles for", dataset_name, ":\n")
    print(time_diff_quantiles)
    
    cat("\nSpeed Quantiles for", dataset_name, ":\n")
    print(speed_quantiles)
    
  } else {
    
    cat("\nNo unrealistic points detected for", dataset_name, ".\n")
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 15) Save outputs if requested
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (!is.null(out_dir)) {
    
    dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    
    cleaned_out <- file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(str_to_lower(dataset_name), "_cleaned_no_unrealistic_points.csv")
    )
    
    unrealistic_out <- file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(str_to_lower(dataset_name), "_unrealistic_points_removed.csv")
    )
    
    suspect_summary_out <- file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(str_to_lower(dataset_name), "_suspect_jump_summary.csv")
    )
    
    write_csv(cleaned_df, cleaned_out)
    write_csv(unrealistic_summary, unrealistic_out)
    write_csv(suspect_summary, suspect_summary_out)
    
    cat("\nSaved cleaned data to:", cleaned_out, "\n")
    cat("Saved unrealistic points to:", unrealistic_out, "\n")
    cat("Saved suspect summary to:", suspect_summary_out, "\n")
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 16) Return useful objects
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  return(
    list(
      cleaned_data = cleaned_df,
      full_flagged_data = df_working,
      unrealistic_points = unrealistic_points,
      unrealistic_summary = unrealistic_summary,
      suspect_summary = suspect_summary,
      flagged_points = flagged_points,
      flagged_ids = flagged_ids
    )
  )
}


# ============================================================
# RUN CLEANING FOR RESIDENT AND MIGRATORY DATASETS
# ============================================================

movement_cleaning_out_dir <- file.path(base_path, "movement_cleaning_outputs")
dir.create(movement_cleaning_out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

#AKDE on migratory
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Sliding-window AKDE + UD list for Migratory Mule Deer
#
# Uses final cleaned migratory data after:
# - relabeling migration_status
# - removing transition to migratory rows
# - removing unrealistic movements
#
# Runs AKDE by ID + Phase
# Example individual.local.identifier: "42_Phase_1"
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(ctmm)
library(lubridate)
library(tibble)
library(zoo)
library(furrr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) File paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

base_path <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

migratory_final_path <- file.path(
  base_path,
  "combined_migratory_ids_cleaned_no_unrealistic_points.csv"
)

akde_out_dir <- file.path(base_path, "akde_outputs")
dir.create(akde_out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

migr_area_out <- file.path(
  akde_out_dir,
  "migratory_AKDE_7day_windows.csv"
)

migr_ud_out <- file.path(
  akde_out_dir,
  "migratory_UD_list.rds"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Helper: safely parse datetime
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parse_datetime_safe <- function(x) {
  parse_date_time(
    x,
    orders = c(
      "Y-m-d H:M:S",
      "Y-m-d H:M",
      "Y-m-d",
      "ymd HMS",
      "ymd HM",
      "ymd",
      "mdy HMS",
      "mdy HM",
      "mdy"
    ),
    tz = "UTC"
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Read cleaned migratory data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migr_data <- read_csv(
  migratory_final_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  clean_names()

cat("Migratory rows loaded:", nrow(migr_data), "\n")
cat("Column<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(names(migr_data))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Standardize datetime column
#
# Your current pipeline uses date.
# If date_time exists instead, this will use date_time.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if ("date_time" %in% names(migr_data)) {
  
  migr_data <- migr_data %>%
    mutate(date_time = parse_datetime_safe(date_time))
  
} else if ("date" %in% names(migr_data)) {
  
  migr_data <- migr_data %>%
    mutate(date_time = parse_datetime_safe(date))
  
} else {
  
  stop("No date or date_time column found in migratory data.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Standardize required columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

required_cols <- c("id", "longitude", "latitude", "date_time", "phases")

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(migr_data))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
    "\nAvailable columns ar<LOCAL_PATH>",
    paste(names(migr_data), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

migr_data <- migr_data %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    phases = as.character(phases),
    
    phases_clean = phases %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_replace_all("_", " "),
    
    phases_clean_lower = str_to_lower(phases_clean)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Drop missing locations/date and remove explicit Remove phases
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migr_clean <- migr_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(longitude),
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(date_time),
    !is.na(phases_clean),
    phases_clean_lower != "remove"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase_num = str_extract(phases_clean_lower, "\\d+"),
    phase_label = if_else(
      !is.na(phase_num),
      paste0("Phase_", phase_num),
      str_replace_all(phases_clean, "\\s+", "_")
    ),
    id_phase = paste(id, phase_label, sep = "_")
  )

cat("\nMigratory rows after AKDE cleaning:", nrow(migr_clean), "\n")
cat("Unique ID_Phase combinations:", n_distinct(migr_clean$id_phase), "\n")

cat("\nID_Phase count<LOCAL_PATH>")
migr_clean %>%
  count(id_phase, sort = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Build sf object and extract lon/lat
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migr_sf <- migr_clean %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

migr_ll <- migr_sf %>%
  st_coordinates() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(
    location.long = X,
    location.lat = Y
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Prepare telemetry dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migr_dat <- migr_clean %>%
  bind_cols(migr_ll) %>%
  select(
    individual.local.identifier = id_phase,
    location.long,
    location.lat,
    timestamp = date_time
  ) %>%
  arrange(individual.local.identifier, timestamp)

# Remove duplicate timestamps within ID_Phase if present
migr_dat <- migr_dat %>%
  distinct(
    individual.local.identifier,
    timestamp,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

cat("\nTelemetry input rows:", nrow(migr_dat), "\n")
cat("Telemetry ID_Phase count:", n_distinct(migr_dat$individual.local.identifier), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Convert to ctmm telemetry list
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migr_tel_list <- as.telemetry(
  migr_dat,
  timeformat = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
  timezone = "UTC"
)

cat("\nTelemetry list length:", length(migr_tel_list), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Parallel plan
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plan(multisession, workers = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1))
options(future.rng.onMisuse = "ignore")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Per-ID_Phase AKDE function
# ------------------------------------------------------------

process_migr_id_phase <- function(deer_id_phase) {
  
  cat("\nProcessing:", deer_id_phase, "\n")
  
  tel <- migr_tel_list[[deer_id_phase]]
  
  day_sec <- 24 * 3600
  week_sec <- 7 * day_sec
  
  # Safety check
  if (is.null(tel)) {
    return(
      list(
        area = tibble(),
        uds = list(),
        status = tibble(
          id_phase = deer_id_phase,
          status = "missing telemetry",
          n_fixes = NA_integer_,
          n_windows = 0
        )
      )
    )
  }
  
  n_fixes <- length(tel$t)
  
  if (n_fixes < 20) {
    return(
      list(
        area = tibble(),
        uds = list(),
        status = tibble(
          id_phase = deer_id_phase,
          status = "skipped fewer than 20 fixes",
          n_fixes = n_fixes,
          n_windows = 0
        )
      )
    )
  }
  
  # Sliding 7-day windows
  starts <- tel$t[tel$t <= max(tel$t) - week_sec]
  
  if (length(starts) == 0) {
    return(
      list(
        area = tibble(),
        uds = list(),
        status = tibble(
          id_phase = deer_id_phase,
          status = "skipped no full 7-day windows",
          n_fixes = n_fixes,
          n_windows = 0
        )
      )
    )
  }
  
  raw_area <- tibble(
    window_start = as.POSIXct(character()),
    low = numeric(),
    est = numeric(),
    high = numeric()
  )
  
  migr_ud_list <- list()
  
  for (t0 in starts) {
    
    win <- tel[tel$t >= t0 & tel$t <= (t0 + week_sec), ]
    
    # Require enough fixes inside the 7-day window
    if (length(win$t) < 20) next
    
    UD_migr <- tryCatch({
      
      v0 <- variogram(win, CI = "Gauss")
      v2 <- variogram.fit(v0, name = "GuessBM", interactive = FALSE)
      m0 <- ctmm.select(win, v2, IC = "BIC")
      akde(win, m0, weights = TRUE)
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      
      message("AKDE failed for ", deer_id_phase, " at ", as.POSIXct(t0, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"), ": ", e$message)
      NULL
    })
    
    if (is.null(UD_migr)) next
    
    migr_ud_list[[length(migr_ud_list) + 1]] <- UD_migr
    
    ci <- tryCatch({
      summary(UD_migr)$CI
    }, error = function(e) {
      NULL
    })
    
    if (is.null(ci)) next
    
    ci_tbl <- as_tibble(ci, rownames = "unit")
    
    area_row <- ci_tbl %>%
      filter(str_starts(unit, "area")) %>%
      select(low, est, high)
    
    if (nrow(area_row) == 0) next
    
    raw_area <- bind_rows(
      raw_area,
      tibble(
        window_start = as.POSIXct(t0, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
        low = area_row$low,
        est = area_row$est,
        high = area_row$high
      )
    )
  }
  
  raw_area <- raw_area %>%
    mutate(
      id_phase = deer_id_phase,
      id = str_extract(deer_id_phase, "^[^_]+"),
      phase = str_replace(deer_id_phase, paste0("^", id, "_"), "")
    ) %>%
    select(id, phase, id_phase, window_start, low, est, high)
  
  status <- tibble(
    id_phase = deer_id_phase,
    status = if_else(nrow(raw_area) > 0, "processed", "no successful AKDE windows"),
    n_fixes = n_fixes,
    n_windows = nrow(raw_area)
  )
  
  list(
    area = raw_area,
    uds = migr_ud_list,
    status = status
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Run AKDE pipeline in parallel
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migr_results <- future_map(
  names(migr_tel_list),
  process_migr_id_phase,
  .progress = TRUE,
  .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
)

names(migr_results) <- names(migr_tel_list)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Extract area dataframe, UD list, and status report
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migr_area_df <- map_dfr(migr_results, "area")

migr_ud_list_by_id_phase <- map(migr_results, "uds")

migr_status_df <- map_dfr(migr_results, "status")

cat("\nAKDE status repor<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(migr_status_df, n = Inf)

cat("\nAKDE area rows:", nrow(migr_area_df), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Verify every ID_Phase combination made it through
# ------------------------------------------------------------

orig_migr_ids <- migr_clean %>%
  distinct(id_phase) %>%
  pull(id_phase)

done_migr_ids <- migr_area_df %>%
  distinct(id_phase) %>%
  pull(id_phase)

missing_ids <- setdiff(orig_migr_ids, done_migr_ids)

if (length(missing_ids) == 0) {
  message("✅ All migratory ID_Phase combinations processed.")
} else {
  message("⚠️ Missing ID_Phase combos: ", paste(missing_ids, collapse = ", "))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 15) Save outputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write_csv(
  migr_area_df,
  migr_area_out
)

saveRDS(
  migr_ud_list_by_id_phase,
  migr_ud_out
)

write_csv(
  migr_status_df,
  file.path(akde_out_dir, "migratory_AKDE_status_report.csv")
)

cat("\nSaved migratory AKDE area CSV to:", migr_area_out, "\n")
cat("Saved migratory UD list RDS to:", migr_ud_out, "\n")
cat("Saved migratory AKDE status report to:", file.path(akde_out_dir, "migratory_AKDE_status_report.csv"), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Sliding-window AKDE + UD list for Resident Mule Deer
#
# Saves ALL outputs to:
# <LOCAL_PATH>
#
# Runs AKDE by ID only
# Resident deer should only have one phase per ID
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(ctmm)
library(lubridate)
library(tibble)
library(zoo)
library(furrr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(janitor)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) File paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

input_base_path <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

resident_final_path <- file.path(
  input_base_path,
  "combined_resident_ids_cleaned_no_unrealistic_points.csv"
)

# NEW HARD DRIVE OUTPUT LOCATION
akde_out_dir <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

dir.create(akde_out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

resident_area_out <- file.path(
  akde_out_dir,
  "resident_AKDE_7day_windows.csv"
)

resident_status_out <- file.path(
  akde_out_dir,
  "resident_AKDE_status_report.csv"
)

resident_failed_out <- file.path(
  akde_out_dir,
  "resident_AKDE_failed_or_missing_ids.csv"
)

resident_ud_out_dir <- file.path(
  akde_out_dir,
  "resident_UD_lists_by_id"
)

dir.create(resident_ud_out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

cat("Input resident CS<LOCAL_PATH>", resident_final_path, "\n\n")
cat("Output director<LOCAL_PATH>", akde_out_dir, "\n\n")
cat("Resident UD output director<LOCAL_PATH>", resident_ud_out_dir, "\n\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Safety checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(resident_final_path)) {
  stop("Resident input CSV does not exist: ", resident_final_path)
}

if (!dir.exists(akde_out_dir)) {
  stop("Output directory could not be created: ", akde_out_dir)
}

# Test write permission to new hard drive
test_file <- file.path(akde_out_dir, "write_test.txt")

tryCatch(
  {
    writeLines("write test", test_file)
    file.remove(test_file)
    cat("✅ Write permission confirmed for:", akde_out_dir, "\n\n")
  },
  error = function(e) {
    stop("Cannot write to output directory: ", akde_out_dir, "\nError: ", e$message)
  }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Helper: safely parse datetime
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parse_datetime_safe <- function(x) {
  parse_date_time(
    x,
    orders = c(
      "Y-m-d H:M:S",
      "Y-m-d H:M",
      "Y-m-d",
      "ymd HMS",
      "ymd HM",
      "ymd",
      "mdy HMS",
      "mdy HM",
      "mdy"
    ),
    tz = "UTC"
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Read cleaned resident data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_data <- read_csv(
  resident_final_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  clean_names()

cat("Resident rows loaded:", nrow(resident_data), "\n")
cat("Column<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(names(resident_data))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Standardize datetime column
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if ("date_time" %in% names(resident_data)) {
  
  resident_data <- resident_data %>%
    mutate(date_time = parse_datetime_safe(date_time))
  
} else if ("date" %in% names(resident_data)) {
  
  resident_data <- resident_data %>%
    mutate(date_time = parse_datetime_safe(date))
  
} else {
  
  stop("No date or date_time column found in resident data.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Check required columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

required_cols <- c("id", "longitude", "latitude", "date_time")

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(resident_data))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
    "\nAvailable columns ar<LOCAL_PATH>",
    paste(names(resident_data), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

resident_data <- resident_data %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Optional resident phase check
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if ("phases" %in% names(resident_data)) {
  
  cat("\nResident phase count<LOCAL_PATH>")
  
  resident_data %>%
    count(id, phases, sort = TRUE) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    print(n = Inf)
  
  phase_check <- resident_data %>%
    mutate(
      phases_clean = phases %>%
        as.character() %>%
        str_trim() %>%
        str_squish() %>%
        str_to_lower()
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(phases_clean), phases_clean != "") %>%
    distinct(id, phases_clean) %>%
    count(id, name = "n_phases") %>%
    filter(n_phases > 1)
  
  if (nrow(phase_check) > 0) {
    warning("Some resident IDs have more than one phase label. Check phase_check.")
    print(phase_check, n = Inf)
  } else {
    message("✅ Resident phase check passed: one phase per ID.")
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Drop missing locations/date
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_clean <- resident_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(longitude),
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(date_time)
  )

cat("\nResident rows after AKDE cleaning:", nrow(resident_clean), "\n")
cat("Unique resident IDs:", n_distinct(resident_clean$id), "\n")

cat("\nResident ID fix count<LOCAL_PATH>")

resident_clean %>%
  count(id, sort = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Build sf object and extract lon/lat
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_sf <- resident_clean %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

resident_ll <- resident_sf %>%
  st_coordinates() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(
    location.long = X,
    location.lat = Y
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Prepare telemetry dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_dat <- resident_clean %>%
  bind_cols(resident_ll) %>%
  select(
    individual.local.identifier = id,
    location.long,
    location.lat,
    timestamp = date_time
  ) %>%
  arrange(individual.local.identifier, timestamp)

# Remove duplicate timestamps within ID
resident_dat <- resident_dat %>%
  distinct(
    individual.local.identifier,
    timestamp,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

cat("\nTelemetry input rows:", nrow(resident_dat), "\n")
cat("Telemetry resident ID count:", n_distinct(resident_dat$individual.local.identifier), "\n")

# Save telemetry input for traceability
resident_telemetry_input_out <- file.path(
  akde_out_dir,
  "resident_telemetry_input_used_for_AKDE.csv"
)

write_csv(resident_dat, resident_telemetry_input_out)

cat("Saved resident telemetry input t<LOCAL_PATH>", resident_telemetry_input_out, "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Convert to ctmm telemetry list
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_tel_list <- as.telemetry(
  resident_dat,
  timeformat = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
  timezone = "UTC"
)

cat("\nTelemetry list length:", length(resident_tel_list), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Parallel plan
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Use fewer workers to avoid memory/write issues
n_workers <- max(1, min(4, parallel::detectCores() - 1))

plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)
options(future.rng.onMisuse = "ignore")

cat("\nUsing", n_workers, "parallel workers.\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Per-ID AKDE function for residents
# ------------------------------------------------------------

process_resident_id <- function(deer_id) {
  
  cat("\nProcessing resident ID:", deer_id, "\n")
  
  tel <- resident_tel_list[[deer_id]]
  
  day_sec <- 24 * 3600
  week_sec <- 7 * day_sec
  
  if (is.null(tel)) {
    return(
      list(
        area = tibble(),
        uds = list(),
        status = tibble(
          id = deer_id,
          status = "missing telemetry",
          n_fixes = NA_integer_,
          n_windows = 0
        )
      )
    )
  }
  
  n_fixes <- length(tel$t)
  
  if (n_fixes < 20) {
    return(
      list(
        area = tibble(),
        uds = list(),
        status = tibble(
          id = deer_id,
          status = "skipped fewer than 20 fixes",
          n_fixes = n_fixes,
          n_windows = 0
        )
      )
    )
  }
  
  starts <- tel$t[tel$t <= max(tel$t) - week_sec]
  
  if (length(starts) == 0) {
    return(
      list(
        area = tibble(),
        uds = list(),
        status = tibble(
          id = deer_id,
          status = "skipped no full 7-day windows",
          n_fixes = n_fixes,
          n_windows = 0
        )
      )
    )
  }
  
  raw_area <- tibble(
    window_start = as.POSIXct(character()),
    low = numeric(),
    est = numeric(),
    high = numeric()
  )
  
  resident_ud_list <- list()
  
  for (t0 in starts) {
    
    win <- tel[tel$t >= t0 & tel$t <= (t0 + week_sec), ]
    
    # Require enough fixes inside each 7-day window
    if (length(win$t) < 20) next
    
    UD_resident <- tryCatch({
      
      v0 <- variogram(win, CI = "Gauss")
      v2 <- variogram.fit(v0, name = "GuessBM", interactive = FALSE)
      m0 <- ctmm.select(win, v2, IC = "BIC")
      akde(win, m0, weights = TRUE)
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      
      message(
        "AKDE failed for resident ID ",
        deer_id,
        " at ",
        as.POSIXct(t0, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
        ": ",
        e$message
      )
      
      NULL
    })
    
    if (is.null(UD_resident)) next
    
    resident_ud_list[[length(resident_ud_list) + 1]] <- UD_resident
    
    ci <- tryCatch({
      summary(UD_resident)$CI
    }, error = function(e) {
      NULL
    })
    
    if (is.null(ci)) next
    
    ci_tbl <- as_tibble(ci, rownames = "unit")
    
    area_row <- ci_tbl %>%
      filter(str_starts(unit, "area")) %>%
      select(low, est, high)
    
    if (nrow(area_row) == 0) next
    
    raw_area <- bind_rows(
      raw_area,
      tibble(
        window_start = as.POSIXct(t0, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
        low = area_row$low,
        est = area_row$est,
        high = area_row$high
      )
    )
  }
  
  raw_area <- raw_area %>%
    mutate(id = deer_id) %>%
    select(id, window_start, low, est, high)
  
  status <- tibble(
    id = deer_id,
    status = if_else(nrow(raw_area) > 0, "processed", "no successful AKDE windows"),
    n_fixes = n_fixes,
    n_windows = nrow(raw_area)
  )
  
  list(
    area = raw_area,
    uds = resident_ud_list,
    status = status
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Run resident AKDE pipeline in parallel
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_results <- future_map(
  names(resident_tel_list),
  process_resident_id,
  .progress = TRUE,
  .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
)

names(resident_results) <- names(resident_tel_list)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 15) Extract area dataframe, UD list, and status report
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_area_df <- map_dfr(resident_results, "area")

resident_ud_list_by_id <- map(resident_results, "uds")

resident_status_df <- map_dfr(resident_results, "status")

cat("\nResident AKDE status repor<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(resident_status_df, n = Inf)

cat("\nResident AKDE area rows:", nrow(resident_area_df), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 16) Verify every resident ID made it through
# ------------------------------------------------------------

orig_resident_ids <- resident_clean %>%
  distinct(id) %>%
  pull(id)

done_resident_ids <- resident_area_df %>%
  distinct(id) %>%
  pull(id)

missing_resident_ids <- setdiff(orig_resident_ids, done_resident_ids)

if (length(missing_resident_ids) == 0) {
  message("✅ All resident IDs processed.")
} else {
  message("⚠️ Missing resident IDs: ", paste(missing_resident_ids, collapse = ", "))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 17) Diagnose failed/missing resident IDs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nResident AKDE status count<LOCAL_PATH>")

resident_status_df %>%
  count(status, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

failed_resident_akde_groups <- resident_status_df %>%
  filter(status != "processed") %>%
  arrange(id)

cat("\nFailed/missing resident AKDE ID<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(failed_resident_akde_groups, n = Inf)

resident_fix_counts <- resident_clean %>%
  count(id, name = "n_original_fixes") %>%
  arrange(id)

cat("\nOriginal fix counts for failed/missing resident ID<LOCAL_PATH>")

failed_resident_akde_groups %>%
  left_join(resident_fix_counts, by = "id") %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 18) Save CSV outputs to SanDisk
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write_csv(
  resident_area_df,
  resident_area_out
)

write_csv(
  resident_status_df,
  resident_status_out
)

write_csv(
  failed_resident_akde_groups,
  resident_failed_out
)

cat("\nSaved resident AKDE area CSV t<LOCAL_PATH>", resident_area_out, "\n")
cat("Saved resident AKDE status report t<LOCAL_PATH>", resident_status_out, "\n")
cat("Saved resident failed/missing ID report t<LOCAL_PATH>", resident_failed_out, "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 19) Save one UD RDS per resident ID to SanDisk
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for (nm in names(resident_ud_list_by_id)) {
  
  safe_nm <- nm %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_")
  
  ud_file <- file.path(
    resident_ud_out_dir,
    paste0(safe_nm, "_UD_list.rds")
  )
  
  this_ud <- resident_ud_list_by_id[[nm]]
  
  if (length(this_ud) > 0) {
    
    tryCatch(
      {
        saveRDS(
          this_ud,
          ud_file,
          compress = "gzip"
        )
        cat("Saved UD list for resident ID:", nm, " | windows:", length(this_ud), "\n")
      },
      error = function(e) {
        message("Could not save UD list for resident ID ", nm, ": ", e$message)
      }
    )
    
  } else {
    
    cat("Skipping empty UD list for resident ID:", nm, "\n")
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 20) Create RDS file index for checking later
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_ud_files <- list.files(
  resident_ud_out_dir,
  pattern = "_UD_list\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

resident_rds_index <- tibble(
  file_path = resident_ud_files,
  file_name = basename(resident_ud_files),
  id = str_remove(file_name, "_UD_list\\.rds$"),
  size_bytes = file.info(file_path)$size
) %>%
  arrange(id)

resident_rds_index_out <- file.path(
  akde_out_dir,
  "resident_UD_RDS_file_index.csv"
)

write_csv(resident_rds_index, resident_rds_index_out)

cat("\nSaved resident RDS file index t<LOCAL_PATH>", resident_rds_index_out, "\n")

cat("\nRDS file size summar<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(summary(resident_rds_index$size_bytes))

cat("\nResident AKDE rerun complete.\n")
cat("All outputs saved t<LOCAL_PATH>", akde_out_dir, "\n")
```
